description: "History of the United Netherlands, 1588" by John Lothrop Motley is a historical account written in the late 19th century. This work provides an in-depth examination of a pivotal moment in European history, focusing on the failed Spanish Armada's invasion of England and the maritime conflict that ensued between England, the Netherlands, and Spain.
